promise: "I will build a great, great wall on our southern border, and I will make Mexico pay for that wall."
description: Signature pledge from his June 16, 2015 campaign announcement, with Mexico to pay. Mexico refused to pay; the US funded the project, mostly by diverting about $15 billion in Pentagon and other funds. By January 2021 only about 458 miles of barriers existed, largely replacements/upgrades of existing fencing, not a full new wall.
evidence: Mexico never contributed; CBP confirmed US-funded construction
~458 miles of border wall built by end of term, much of it replacement fencing
Pentagon funds diverted (~$15B) despite congressional objections
